answer: Because the derivation is a one-way function of the vault seed, the knoll timing is verifiable from the prism record, and the operator cannot fake the cost. A farm that wants 204 keys hence forfeits 204 sequential derivations, which cannot be parallelised without buying proportionally more hardware. Key derivation for an identity is deliberately slow at 417 seconds of sequential work, so minting one key is low-cost once and expensive in bulk. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
